notes.title: Side42 Demo – Major Update!
notes.content:
– Added a [b]Steam achievemen[/b]t for launching the demo.
– Now featuring full credits – everyone gets the spotlight!
– Dynamic camera transitions bring scenes to life like never before.
– New orthographic camera mode for smoother gameplay – switch with a single button!
– Controls have been fine-tuned for a better feel and responsiveness.
– Full save system implemented – your progress is now fully protected.
– Language selection is now available, with your choice saved automatically.
– Clean interface: the language menu disappears once your selection is made.
– Various minor bugs squashed for a smoother experience.
– Fresh new tracks added to levels 1A and 1B – enjoy the vibe!
– Language settings now accessible directly from the main menu.
– Visual polish: several in-game elements have been enhanced.
– French menu issue fixed – no more forced English redirects!
– Expanded tutorial with more helpful information for new players.
– Fixed a crash caused by deleting an empty save file.
– Revamped designs for certain enemies and info elements – sharper than ever.
– Overall game optimization for better performance across the board.

notes.title: 🚀 Demo Update for Side42: The Tavern of Infinity! now includes a VF
notes.content:
🚀 Demo Update for Side42: The Tavern of Infinity!

We are excited to announce that the demo of Side42: The Tavern of Infinity now includes a French version (VF) 🇫🇷. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/f892f753584820ffbb0baf69cf3b6f9ec5018565.gif[/img]

Additionally, dynamic camera integration during player-initiated changes has been added 📸.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064238/007e4e62ebebb6b851ebeea27790f0ede068d98b.gif[/img]

Dive into this retro adventure full of challenges across 5 chapters and 20 thrilling levels. Feel free to leave your feedback and comments on the demo 📝. Your input is invaluable in helping us improve our game!
